note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a SUD 7; A06b SUD 7; L05 SUD 10(2)): ordinary naturalisation after 10 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: Gender restriction: no or restricted access if the mother is a citizen (wedlock condition/supplementary provision may apply)), A01b (descent, born abroad: Gender restriction: no or restricted access if the mother is a citizen (wedlock condition/supplementary provision may apply)), A02a (birth in country: No provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: No provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: not by birth in the territory alone (provisions for foundlings and children otherwise stateless, modes A03a and A03b, aren't held by the form); by descent from the father only, a child born abroad on the limit the dataset states. Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Sudan, 2024
sources.said: Person has been lawfully and continuously resident in Sudan for 10 years or more. ... n.a. ... Person has acquired de jure or de facto, the citizenship of South Sudan. ... Gender restriction: no or restricted access if the mother is a citizen (wedlock condition/supplementary provision may apply) ... Person is born in Sudan to a father who is a citizen.; Person is born in Sudan to a mother who is a citizen and the child applies for citizenship. (Note: constitution provides that the child of a father or mother has an inalienable right to citizenship. Definition of 'father' in the act includes mother if born out of wedlock or if descent not established to father.) ... Gender restriction: no or restricted access if the mother is a citizen (wedlock condition/supplementary provision may apply) ... Person is born outside Sudan to a father who is a citizen.; Person is born outside Sudan to a mother who is a citizen and the person applies for citizenship. (Note: constitution provides that the child of a father or mother has an inalienable right to citizenship. Definition of 'father' in the act includes mother if born out of wedlock or if descent not established to father. A person born outside Sudan to a parent who is a citizen by naturalisation will be a citizen by birth if the parent has domicile in Sudan.) ... No provision ... No provision

atBirth.descentAbroad: Person is born outside Sudan to a father who is a citizen.; Person is born outside Sudan to a mother who is a citizen and the person applies for citizenship. (Note: constitution provides that the child of a father or mother has an inalienable right to citizenship. Definition of 'father' in the act includes mother if born out of wedlock or if descent not established to father. A person born outside Sudan to a parent who is a citizen by naturalisation will be a citizen by birth if the parent has domicile in Sudan.)
